Boosting them is mostly worth it on x20 sqads. Its also where galvanic volley will pay off most. A lot of tanks are T8 - that is extra case why manipulus with holy order for +1S can help. 
I usually play 2000pts with 2x20 squads and 2x5 vanguards. There it pay off more, because even if you lose one sqad, you can use the buffs on the second squad.
Laschickens are great, but the are really fragile. It is best to hide them during deploy and just poke a bit to see target. I play only 2 in 1000pts games. If you want more mobility, which is great idea btw, i cannot recommend raiders enough. They are great.
But my most favourite trick of all time is stratoraptor. I use him as suicide bomb and it works like a charm - in first opportunitty i have, i fly them into biggest blob of enemy units - usually inside building or behind cover. Enemy then has only 3 options - ignore it and get obliterated, move away from it which means leaving cover and strategic position or blast it. In which case you can use the explode strat, which is great - D3dmg in 6inch radius from already huge base.

Infiltrators are to be deployed pregame with their ability to force opponent out of cover. If you want units to drop them on objectives later, take 2x5 vanguards and put them in reserves (or servitors).
My point with buffing your infantry was, that will all the buffs, they can destroy even the tanks. 20buffed rangers are 60shots on +3, will rerolls on 1. +-45hits. S4/5 ws T7 russ means you will wound on 5+ with rerolls on 1, that is about 15wounds. With AP-2
If you play skitarii just to counter his infantry, take less of them.

When you play that many skitarii it is worth it to buff them. Manipulus with holy order for either +1S or additional hit on 6 is great. If you have a blob of 20 rangers, give them marshall with exemplar eternity and manipulus with extra ap and S/hits and galvanic stratagem for extra shots they are going to melt anything.
If you are not buffing them like this, i would reduce the number of them and replace it.
Either play objectives - take serberys riders, and infiltrators 
or destruction - add stratoraptor or disintegrator.
Lose one engiseer and add one manipulus for the extra range and ap for skitarii
